request: Does the sofa colour go with the floor? Explain the visible palette and one optional small improvement. Do not change anything.

reply.message:
The sofa’s muted sage green suits the warm beige rug, brown wood tones and terracotta chair specified in your scene—an earthy, balanced palette.

I can’t confirm its match with the floor: no render or floor finish is provided here. If the floor is warm natural wood, the sage should complement it nicely.

One optional small improvement: a lighter cream colour for the existing rug would give the sofa more definition. Nothing has been changed.
